concept.title: Scuffed Midsole, Meet the Beat
concept.hook: Macro shot of a scuffed white leather midsole on a workbench, with the stiff brush entering frame. Overlay: Scuffed midsoles end here.
concept.surpriseBeat: At the 10 second mark the frame splits into a before and after of the same midsole, the clean half snapping in with a percussive click.

locations.description: Clean concrete-top workbench beside a window, with the zip pouch, brushes and towel laid out in a neat row
locations.lighting: Soft warm side light from the window, strong contrast, fine grain

scenes.action: A white leather low-top with a scuffed midsole sits on the workbench. The stiff brush enters and scrubs the midsole in short strokes.
scenes.framing: Tight macro on the midsole and bristles, shallow depth of field
scenes.motion: Brush strokes in time with the beat, shoe stays still
scenes.lighting: Soft side key light showing texture
scenes.sound: Lo-fi beat starts on the first kick, bristle scrub texture, dry snare snaps

scenes.action: The zip pouch lies open on the bench, showing the cleaner, two brushes and one towel. The foaming cleaner is pumped onto the midsole and the stiff brush works it in.
scenes.framing: Top down on the bench with the kit laid out and the shoe at the edge
scenes.motion: Pump presses once, brush sweeps, kit items stay still
scenes.lighting: Warm side light with soft shadows
scenes.dialogue: Cleaner, two brushes, one towel. That's the whole kit.
scenes.sound: Soft pump click, foam hiss, electric piano loop

scenes.action: The gray microfiber towel wipes the foam off in one clean sweep, revealing a bright midsole.
scenes.framing: Mid close shot of the towel and the shoe's side
scenes.motion: Single confident wipe from heel to toe
scenes.sound: Towel swipe, percussive click on the reveal

scenes.action: Split screen of the same midsole: scuffed on the left, bright on the right.
scenes.framing: Vertical split screen, same angle on both halves
scenes.motion: The shoe is still, the divider line snaps in
scenes.lighting: Matching warm side light on both halves
scenes.sound: Sharp click and a bass note on the split

scenes.action: The kit is packed into the zip pouch beside the clean pair. The pouch sits still while the camera pushes in slowly.
scenes.framing: Medium shot of the pouch and the finished pair on the bench
scenes.motion: Hands set the pouch down and leave the frame, then everything is still
scenes.dialogue: Twenty-eight dollars. Come get the kit.
scenes.sound: Zip sound, beat resolves on a soft kick

rubric.reason: Faithful to the brief's sequence, with clear product use and a clean split-screen beat. The surprise is the quietest of the three because the before and after is expected.

concept.title: Mud Splatter Meltdown
concept.hook: A gray knit runner caked in mud splatter sits on an entryway mat. Overlay: That pair deserves better than a wet paper towel.
concept.surpriseBeat: The towel wipes once across the muddy knit and the foam lifts away to reveal clean gray mesh underneath.

locations.description: Small apartment entryway with a mat and a bench, the muddy runner on the mat
locations.lighting: Warm, soft light from the side, strong contrast

scenes.action: A gray knit runner with mud splatter is set down on the entryway mat. A wet paper towel lies crumpled beside it.
scenes.framing: Fast zoom from a mid shot to a tight shot of the mud on the knit
scenes.motion: The shoe is set down once and stays still
scenes.lighting: Warm side light that shows the mud texture
scenes.overlayText: That pair deserves better than a wet paper towel.
scenes.sound: Dull thud as the shoe lands, beat enters on a punchy kick

scenes.action: The zip pouch sits open on the bench. The person in a plain heather gray hoodie lifts out the foaming cleaner and sets it next to the shoe.
scenes.framing: Mid shot of the bench, torso and hands only
scenes.motion: Hands lift the cleaner and set it down, label turned to camera

scenes.action: The cleaner pumps into a thick lather on the knit and the soft brush works it in with small circles.
scenes.framing: Tight macro on the knit upper and the soft bristles
scenes.motion: Small circular strokes timed to the snare
scenes.lighting: Soft side light with shallow depth of field on the foam
scenes.sound: Foam hiss, bristle rustle, dry snare snaps

scenes.action: The gray microfiber towel sweeps across the lather and the foam lifts to show clean mesh.
scenes.framing: Tight shot of the upper, the towel crossing frame once
scenes.sound: Towel swipe and a percussive click on the reveal

scenes.action: The kit is packed back into the zip pouch and set next to the clean runner on the mat.
scenes.framing: Medium shot of the runner and the closed pouch
scenes.motion: The pouch is set down and the hands leave the frame
scenes.dialogue: Get the kit. Your sneakers will notice.

rubric.reason: The wet paper towel hook from the brief is a strong first second, and the wipe reveal is a clear escalation. Several product beats sit close together, so the focus is a little split.

concept.title: Shelf Corner, Quietly Particular
concept.hook: A tidy sneaker shelf corner where one cream canvas pair stands out as the only dull one. Overlay: Your shelf is clean. Your sneakers should be too.
concept.surpriseBeat: A friend glances at the finished cream canvas pair and looks twice, thinking it is brand new.

locations.description: Bright home corner with a wooden floor and a shelf of neatly lined sneakers
locations.lighting: Bright, slightly warm, soft side light

locations.description: Small apartment entryway with a mat and a bench
locations.lighting: Warm soft light from the side

scenes.action: A shelf of tidy sneakers, with one dull cream canvas pair in the middle. The person in a solid black tee lifts it off the shelf.
scenes.framing: Tilts up from the wooden floor to the shelf, torso and hands only
scenes.motion: One steady lift of the shoes
scenes.overlayText: Your shelf is clean. Your sneakers should be too.
scenes.sound: Lo-fi beat begins, shoe lifted off the shelf

scenes.action: The zip pouch is set on the bench and opened. Cleaner, two brushes and one towel are laid out in a row.
scenes.framing: Top down on the bench with each item in view
scenes.motion: Items are placed one by one, then still
scenes.sound: Zipper, small click as each item lands on the beat

scenes.action: Foam is worked into the canvas with the soft brush, then the stiff brush scrubs the sole edge.
scenes.framing: Tight orbit around the shoe, macro on the foam and bristles
scenes.motion: Brush strokes in rhythm with the snare
scenes.lighting: Side light with shallow depth of field
scenes.sound: Bristle scrub, foam hiss, piano loop

scenes.action: The towel wipes away the foam to reveal bright cream canvas, and the pair is placed back on the shelf, now the brightest on it.
scenes.framing: Whip pan from the bench to the shelf corner
scenes.motion: Quick wipe, then the shoes are set back in line
scenes.sound: Whoosh, percussive click as the pair lands on the shelf

scenes.action: A friend in their late twenties looks at the pair, then at the owner, and nods. The pouch sits on the bench, zipped.
scenes.framing: Medium shot of the two adults beside the shelf, pair in the foreground
scenes.motion: Friend leans in and nods, the owner stays calm
scenes.sound: Soft zip, beat resolves, friend's quiet laugh

rubric.reason: The shelf hook is relatable and the friend's second look adds a human payoff. It has two locations and a softer surprise, so it is less punchy than the mud concept.
